## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `make ci` passes (formatting, vet, lint, govulncheck, race tests, coverage).
- [ ] No generated file was edited by hand (files headed `Code generated by sdkgen ... DO NOT EDIT.`); API changes come from the spec.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `[Unreleased]`, if users would notice the change.
- [ ] An incompatible change to the exported API carries the `breaking-change` label, and the CHANGELOG says what users must change.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens or customer data in the code, tests or this description.
